title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Google launches the Connected Apps Platform: businesses expose apps to Gemini via cloud-hosted or Android MCP servers
bullets.summary: More than 50 apps are live in Gemini; it is a US waitlist preview, announced Oct 28.
bullets.how: The Construct: confirms MCP as the integration standard for consumer-scale agents. Brand 9 Signs: a future channel where AI shopping/quote flows could be exposed to Gemini. PRAGMA: sellable offer to wrap client apps as MCP servers.

bullets.title: Microsoft introduces the Copilot harness: a multi-model agentic runtime through Foundry
bullets.summary: Microsoft positions a harness for truly multi-model agentic work (Oct 28), the same routing trend as GitHub Copilot Fusion.
bullets.how: The Construct: validates our multi-model orchestration layer; track its tool/skill conventions. PRAGMA: enterprise-client framing for model-agnostic agent builds. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Anthropic launches tools showing companies what their AI spend is buying
bullets.summary: Per-team views of work, cost and workflow breakdowns for Claude usage (reported Oct 28).
bullets.how: The Construct: use the same per-agent cost/outcome view on our own ecosystem. PRAGMA: ROI-reporting is a ready consulting deliverable. Brand 9 Signs: low-moderate, track Claude spend per workflow.

bullets.title: Deepgram acquires Daily, maker of the Pipecat voice-agent framework
bullets.summary: Consolidates open-source voice-agent infrastructure with speech models (reported Oct 29).
bullets.how: The Construct: Pipecat is a candidate stack for voice agents (phone quoting). Brand 9 Signs: inbound call/quote handling for signage leads. PRAGMA: voice-agent builds for clients.

bullets.title: Anthropic research: AI-agent "judgment calls" in analyst workflows
bullets.summary: In the study, the agent's assigned lean predicted analysts' recommendations 86% of the time, so agent framing steers outcomes.
bullets.how: The Construct: assigned priors/personas in our agents will bias recommendations; audit them. PRAGMA: governance point for client agent deployments. Brand 9 Signs: relevant to bid/quote agents.

praxis_lesson: Agent role framing measurably steers outcomes (86% alignment with the assigned lean), so every Construct agent's persona and priors should be audited and logged as deliberately as its tools and costs.
